Thanks, Sergio — quick note from my side. Procurement and security teams need to join the run-through. Also two folks will be traveling that day (in transit between customer sites) so a single 60-minute block on Nov 24 will be tight.

Can we either: 1) push to the following week when everyone is back, or 2) split the session into two focused blocks (platform + product one day, procurement + security a separate session)? Procurement wants time to review data flow and contract milestones; security wants a short walkthrough of telemetry and audit logs.

Maya and I are leaning toward splitting into a 90-minute technical run + a 60-minute procurement/security review. Open to what works for you — we have travel windows on Nov 24-26 afternoon, back on Nov 29.

Thanks — Alex
